pairs: separated for the Gospel of God,
quod ante promiserat per prophetas suos in Scripturis sanctis
which he had promised beforehand, through his Prophets, in the Holy Scriptures,
qui factus est ei ex semine David secundum carnem,
who was made for him from the offspring of David according to the flesh,
qui prædestinatus est Filius Dei in virtute secundum spiritum sanctificationis ex resurrectione mortuorum Jesu Christi Domini nostri:
the Son of God, who was predestined in virtue according to the Spirit of sanctification from the resurrection of the dead, our Lord Jesus Christ,
through whom we have received grace and Apostleship,
et apostolatum ad obediendum fidei in omnibus gentibus pro nomine ejus,
for the sake of his name, for the obedience of faith among all the Gentiles,
in quibus estis et vos vocati Jesu Christi:
from whom you also have been called by Jesus Christ:
To all who are at Rome,
et pax a Deo Patre nostro,
from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Primum quidem gratias ago Deo meo per Jesum Christum pro omnibus vobis: quia fides vestra annuntiatur in universo mundo.
Certainly, I give thanks to my God, through Jesus Christ, first for all of you, because your faith is being announced throughout the entire world.
cui servio in spiritu meo in Evangelio Filii ejus,
whom I serve in my spirit by the Gospel of his Son,
quod sine intermissione memoriam vestri facio
that without ceasing I have kept a remembrance of you
always in my prayers, pleading that in some way,
si quomodo tandem aliquando prosperum iter habeam in voluntate Dei veniendi ad vos.
I may have a prosperous journey, within the will of God, to come to you.
For I long to see you,
ut aliquid impertiar vobis gratiæ spiritualis ad confirmandos vos:
so that I may impart to you a certain spiritual grace to strengthen you,
simul consolari in vobis per eam quæ invicem est,
to be consoled together with you through that which is mutual:
But I want you to know,
quia sæpe proposui venire ad vos (et prohibitus sum usque adhuc) ut aliquem fructum habeam
that I have often intended to come to you,
(though I have been hindered even to the present time) so that I might obtain some fruit among you also,
just as also among the other Gentiles.
To the Greeks and to the uncivilized,
to the wise and to the foolish,
ita (quod in me) promptum est et vobis, qui Romæ estis, evangelizare.
So within me there is a prompting to evangelize to you also who are at Rome.
For I am not ashamed of the Gospel.
Virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti,
For it is the power of God unto salvation for all believers,
Justitia enim Dei in eo revelatur ex fide in fidem:
For the justice of God is revealed within it, by faith unto faith,
“For the just one lives by faith.”
Revelatur enim ira Dei de cælo super omnem impietatem, et injustitiam hominum eorum, qui veritatem Dei in injustitia detinent:
For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven over every impiety and injustice among those men who fend off the truth of God with injustice.
quia quod notum est Dei, manifestum est in illis.
For what is known about God is manifest in them.
For God has manifested it to them.
Invisibilia enim ipsius, a creatura mundi,
For unseen things about him have been made conspicuous,
since the creation of the world,
being understood by the things that were made;
sempiterna quoque ejus virtus, et divinitas:
likewise his everlasting virtue and divinity,
so much so that they have no excuse.
For although they had known God,
they became weakened in their thoughts,
et obscuratum est insipiens cor eorum:
and their foolish heart was obscured.
For, while proclaiming themselves to be wise,
Et mutaverunt gloriam incorruptibilis Dei in similitudinem imaginis corruptibilis hominis,
And they exchanged the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man,
Propter quod tradidit illos Deus in desideria cordis eorum,
God handed them over to the desires of their own heart for impurity,
ut contumeliis afficiant corpora sua in semetipsis:
so that they afflicted their own bodies with indignities among themselves.
qui commutaverunt veritatem Dei in mendacium:
And they exchanged the truth of God for a lie.
And they worshipped and served the creature,
et servierunt creaturæ potius quam Creatori,
who is blessed for all eternity.
Propterea tradidit illos Deus in passiones ignominiæ:
Because of this, God handed them over to shameful passions.
nam feminæ eorum immutaverunt naturalem usum in eum usum qui est contra naturam.
For example, their females have exchanged the natural use of the body for a use which is against nature.
abandoning the natural use of females,
exarserunt in desideriis suis in invicem,
have burned in their desires for one another:
males doing with males what is disgraceful,
et mercedem, quam oportuit, erroris sui in semetipsis recipientes.
and receiving within themselves the recompense that necessarily results from their error.
Et sicut non probaverunt Deum habere in notitia,
And since they did not prove to have God by knowledge,
tradidit illos Deus in reprobum sensum,
God handed them over to a morally depraved way of thinking,
ut faciant ea quæ non conveniunt,
so that they might do those things which are not fitting:
having been completely filled with all iniquity,
non intellexerunt quoniam qui talia agunt,
though they had known the justice of God,
did not understand that those who act in such a manner are deserving of death,
et non solum qui ea faciunt,
and not only those who do these things,
but also those who consent to what is done.
